items.name: ERC Starting Grant 2027
items.summary: For researchers post-PhD (eligibility widened to 10 years from 2027). Up to €1.5M for 5 years. Bottom-up: any research topic. Call opens July 2026, deadline 14 October 2026.

items.name: EWUU i4PH Seed Call 2026 – Preventive health transitions
items.summary: Seed funding from the TU/e–WUR–UU–UMCU alliance for transdisciplinary preventive-health projects that fit an i4PH research line (healthy start, healthy living environments, future of cancer, health at home) and a transition pathway (incl. 'planetary-centred'). Meant to produce a tangible next step such as a Horizon Europe or NWA application, white paper or review. Total €200k, about 4–5 projects; projects start from 1 Jan 2027 and budget must be spent before 1 Dec 2027.
items.partnersNote: At least three co-applicants from at least three EWUU institutions (TU/e, WUR, UU, UMC Utrecht); main applicant postdoc, assistant or associate professor

items.name: Call for Validation of Biomarker Candidates 2027
items.summary: Funds multidisciplinary consortia (at least 4 parties, private partners allowed) to clinically validate known cancer biomarkers towards use in daily practice, EUR 0.8-2M per project over 2-5 years. An (early) HTA, biostatistics expertise, a development plan and patient involvement are mandatory. Pre-proposals close 20 Oct 2026 (12:00); full proposals 15 Dec 2026-23 Feb 2027, decision June 2027.
items.partnersNote: Multidisciplinary consortium of at least 4 participating parties; AI projects must involve AI4Health consortium

items.name: KNMP Studentenprijs (annual pharmacy student prize)
items.summary: Annual KNMP prize (certificate plus EUR 1,000) for outstanding master pharmacy students, nominated by their teachers and professors for strong study results and commitment to pharmacy education and the profession. Six winners in 2025, awarded at the KNMP Najaarscongres in late October (the 2026 congress is on 27 October 2026). No public nomination deadline is published, as nominations come from faculty. The date shown is the award ceremony (latest possible), not a published nomination deadline.
items.partnersNote: Nomination by hoogleraar/docent

items.name: COST Open Call OC-2026-1 – New COST Actions (research networks)
items.summary: Bottom-up call for new COST Actions, European science and technology networks that fund meetings, short-term scientific missions, training schools and dissemination, not the research itself. A proposal needs at least seven COST member countries, at least half of them Inclusiveness Target Countries, and at least 40% young researchers. Up to 80 Actions may be approved. The collection date is 28 October 2026, 12:00 CET.
items.partnersNote: Network of at least 7 COST Full/Cooperating Members, at least 50% from Inclusiveness Target Countries; at least 40% Young Researchers and Innovators.

items.name: PhRMA Foundation – Value Assessment & Health Outcomes Research Pre- & Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
items.summary: PhRMA Foundation fellowships in value assessment and health outcomes research: postdoctoral USD 60,000/yr and predoctoral USD 30,000/yr stipend, for 12-24 months. The 2027 postdoctoral cycle opened 31 August 2026 and closes 30 October 2026 (noon ET); awards announced March 2027. The predoctoral page still shows the 2026 cycle (deadline was 30 Oct 2025) and says the 2027 cycle launches soon. Applicants must be at an accredited US university, so mainly relevant for US-based collaborators.
items.partnersNote: Applicant must be based at an accredited US university (US and non-US citizens eligible)

items.name: Sustainability Education Community Fund (UU)
items.summary: Small grants for bottom-up sustainability-education initiatives at UU such as workshops, seminars and pilots; covers assistance and material costs (incl. travel and events), not teaching-hour reductions. €12,500 available in this round; decisions 6–8 weeks after the deadline.
items.partnersNote: Main applicant must be a UU employee or student

items.name: Vidi – Science Domain 2026
items.summary: NWO Vidi for researchers moving into leadership who obtained their PhD within eight years before 1 October 2026 (extensions possible). Up to EUR 850,000 for up to five years to build a research line and group; requires an embedding guarantee from a Dutch host institution. Science-domain pre-proposals are due 3 November 2026, 14:00 CET; invited full proposals are due 6 April 2027, 14:00 CEST.

items.name: Exploration Call 2027-1
items.summary: KWF project call for basic and credentialing research into the biological and psychosocial mechanisms behind cancer onset, growth, spread and impact; relevant for mechanistic work on anticancer drugs. Call 2027-1 accepts pre-proposals from 1 September to 3 November 2026 (12:00); invited full proposals run 15 February to 13 April 2027, with interviews in June and decisions in August 2027. KWF describes this as its last project-based basic-research call before switching to research group funding from 2028.

items.name: International Joint Initiative 2026 – Disruptive Technologies for Global Challenges
items.summary: International call (NWO with NFRF and other funders) for interdisciplinary consortia of at least three PIs funded by different participating agencies, using disruptive technologies to address the SDGs. NWO funding is limited to projects on SDG 2, 6, 7 or 11 and is max EUR 760,000 per project; the NWO budget was raised to EUR 6.84M in August 2026. LOIs were due 9 June 2026; only invited applicants can now submit full proposals by 3 November 2026 (NFRF portal), with NWO's ISAAC part due 4 November 2026, 14:00 CET.
items.partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 2 countries from participating funders: NWO, NFRF-Canada, NordForsk, Research Ireland, UKRI, etc.)

items.name: Vidi – ZonMw Health Research and Medical Sciences Domain 2026
items.summary: 2026 Vidi round for the ZonMw Health Research and Medical Sciences domain, aimed at researchers moving into a leadership role who obtained their PhD within eight years of 1 October 2026. Up to €850,000 for a project of up to five years. Two-stage: pre-proposals due 3 November 2026 (14:00 CET); invited applicants submit full proposals by 6 April 2027 (14:00 CEST). Applications go through Mijn ZonMw and need a dean-signed embedding guarantee.

items.name: KIC Demand-driven Research by Consortia – XL
items.summary: NWO KIC call for large public-private consortia tackling societal challenges, with NWO funding EUR 1.4M-7M per proposal (up to 70% of costs) for up to six years and a EUR 14M call ceiling. At least 30% co-funding is required, part of it private cash. The mandatory pre-proposal deadline was 10 March 2026; full proposals are due 12 November 2026, 14:00 CET (only for those who submitted a pre-proposal).
items.partnersNote: Consortium required: knowledge institutions + societal/industry partners (co-funding needed)

items.name: SME Call 2027 (MKB Call)
items.summary: Health~Holland call for public-private R&D projects between SMEs and research organisations (industrial research, TRL 4-6, max 2 years). Consortia can request EUR 225,000-450,000 in PPP subsidy (research organisations max EUR 150,000 per project), at least EUR 8M total for about 20 projects. The lead applicant must be a Dutch for-profit company, and all partners must co-finance. Full applications are due 20 November 2026, 17:00 CET.
items.partnersNote: Public-private partnership with SME required

items.name: Applied Data Science (ADS) Research Grants – autumn 2026 round
items.summary: The UU focus area Applied Data Science funds small interfaculty projects of up to €5,000 that apply or develop data science methods. It also funds seed money for preparing interdisciplinary grant applications and consultation costs when a data scientist from another faculty helps. UU and UMC Utrecht researchers are eligible. Calls have run about twice a year (May/June and November; the last form was dated 22 November 2025), but the next date is not published.
items.partnersNote: Interfaculty collaboration expected (UU/UMCU)

items.name: CARB-X 2026 Funding Round 2 – Antibacterial Research (all themes)
items.summary: CARB-X's second 2026 funding round accepts expressions of interest from 10 to 23 November 2026 across all four 2026 themes: direct-acting therapeutics for Gram-negative infections, the Novel Chemistry for AMR Challenge (target-based therapeutics), non-vaccine prevention of neonatal sepsis, and neonatal sepsis diagnostics. Successful applicants must cover part of the project cost. Funding amounts per award are not stated on the application page.

items.name: MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026
items.summary: OPEN. MSCA Doctoral Networks call HORIZON-MSCA-2026-DN-01 funds international doctoral training networks with 3-year PhD positions and mobility. Opened 28 May 2026; deadline 24 November 2026 (17:00 Brussels). Indicative call budget EUR 593.03M (over 130 projects expected). The division already runs the EU2P programme.
items.partnersNote: Network of min. 3 organisations from 3 different countries required

items.name: Utrechts Universiteitsfonds – Funding for researchers (round 6, 2026)
items.summary: Grants for UU employees for research visits abroad and for research and education costs (e.g. hiring help, materials, organising a congress), applied for through the UU subsidy portal. Six rounds per year; not every fund type is open in every round, and each fund has its own criteria.

items.name: Utrechts Universiteitsfonds – Student support (international exchange/internship), round 6 2026
items.summary: The Utrecht University Fund's student programme helps fund an international exchange or internship, for example a master's research internship abroad. Applicants must be a Student Friend of the Fund (€10 a year). Named funds within the Fund may set their own criteria. About €80,000 a year is available across all student grants. In 2026 there are six rounds, and round 6 runs from 2 to 27 November 2026.

items.name: KNMP Zorginnovatieprijs 2027
items.summary: Annual KNMP prize of €10,000 plus a certificate for an innovation in pharmacist care that is not yet standard or widely implemented. The jury scores relative advantage, compatibility, reduced complexity, testability and visibility; finalists then go to a member vote, and the prize is presented at the KNMP Voorjaarscongres. Only KNMP members (community and hospital pharmacists) can enter. For the 2026 edition, entries opened around 30 September and closed around 28 November (week 48), so the 2027 dates shown are estimated.
items.partnersNote: Entrant must be a KNMP member

items.name: Rubicon 2026-3 (postdoc research abroad)
items.summary: Lets recent PhD graduates (PhD within 12 months before the deadline, or a supervisor's declaration that the thesis is approved) spend 12–24 months at a research institute outside the Netherlands. It covers salary, travel and limited research costs; the round budget of €3,145,000 is shared across the four NWO domains. Applications are individual and due 1 December 2026, 14:00.

items.name: GGG – Alledaagse Aandoeningen in de huisartsenpraktijk (Common Conditions in General Practice)
items.summary: Good Use of Medicines (GGG) round for research on questions from the NHG general-practice knowledge agenda, aiming at more effective, safer or more efficient use of medicines already registered in the Netherlands for common conditions. Total budget is €5 million with no fixed cap per project; multicentre studies may be needed. Project ideas are due 7 December 2026; invited full applications are due 31 May 2027, with a decision expected end of October 2027. The applicant must take part in UNH-Research through a university general-practice department.
items.partnersNote: Applicant must participate in UNH-Research via a university general-practice department (e.g. partner with a GP department such as UMC Utrecht/Julius Center).

items.name: Prix Galien Research Award Nederland 2027
items.summary: Dutch prize (gold medal) for a promising early-career researcher without an ordinary chair whose pharmacological research programme at a Dutch institution clearly exceeds PhD level; self-nomination needs a third-party recommendation. The 2027 cycle has not been announced; in the most recent published rules registration closed 13 Dec 2024 with dossiers due 7 Mar 2025, so the date shown is a projection and not confirmed.

items.name: Geneesmiddelen VIMP 2026-1 (Dissemination & Implementation Impulse)
items.summary: VIMP (dissemination and implementation boost) within ZonMw's Goed Gebruik Geneesmiddelen programme, helping finished ZonMw-funded research on good medicine use (completed no more than three years ago) get used in practice; dissemination alone is not enough. Max EUR 50,000 and 18 months per project from a EUR 250,000 budget; open since 22 June 2026, deadline 22 December 2026, 14:00, though it may close earlier if the budget runs out. Applicant must be a legal entity in the Netherlands, and applications are in Dutch.

items.name: KNMP Stipendiafonds (international study trip grant)
items.summary: KNMP stipend for pharmacy students at Groningen, Leiden and Utrecht who go abroad for at least two weeks for research that is part of their pharmacy study; applicant must be a candidate KNMP member and must not have started the research yet. Applications are judged three times a year (closing dates 1 January, 1 July and 1 October). A 'light' application gives EUR 300-500; a 'heavy' application (meeting at least two high-potential criteria) can give a higher, unspecified amount. Each student may apply only once.

items.name: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027
items.summary: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027 for researchers 5-15 years after their PhD (extensions possible for e.g. parental leave). Up to EUR 2M for 5 years, plus up to EUR 1M extra for justified costs. Bottom-up, any research topic. The call opened 24 September 2026 and closes 12 January 2027.

items.name: Open Competition Domain Science – XS 2027 (Packet 27-1)
items.summary: Small grants (up to EUR 50k, up to 1 year in previous rounds) for promising, speculative ideas in the NWO Science domain, assessed in three packets per year. The 2026 call had packets closing 13 Jan, 14 Apr and 15 Sep 2026. A 2027 call has not been announced; the date shown is projected from packet 26-1 and is not confirmed.

items.name: KHMW Proefschriftprijs Interdisciplinariteit 2027
items.summary: KHMW prize of EUR 10,000 (funded by the ESM Foundation) for one strongly interdisciplinary PhD thesis bridging the natural, social and humanities sciences, researched at a Dutch institution. The 2027 edition is for defences between 1 September 2025 and 31 August 2026. KHMW will open nominations in November 2026; the deadline is not yet published (the previous one was 15 January).

items.name: SSH Open Competition XS (Explore) 2027 – Round 1
items.summary: Small NWO grants (up to EUR 50k in 2026 rounds) for innovative social sciences and humanities research. NWO pre-announced three XS rounds in 2027 with deadlines expected in January, April and September, and from 2027 researchers can apply directly after their PhD; one application per calendar year across the SSH Open Competition. Exact round-1 date not confirmed; date shown is projected from 2026 round 1 (20 Jan 2026).

items.name: Veni – ZonMw Health Research Domain 2026/2027
items.summary: NWO Veni in the ZonMw Health Research and Development domain: up to EUR 320,000 for up to three years for researchers with a PhD obtained within three years before 1 January 2026 (or between 1 January and 2 September 2026). The pre-proposal deadline was 1 September 2026 and no new applications are possible. Applicants with a positive pre-proposal decision submit full proposals by 26 January 2027, 14:00 CET.

items.name: ERA4Health IICS4all 2027 (JTC9) – Investigator-Initiated Clinical Studies in Cardiovascular, Autoimmune, Metabolic & Respiratory Diseases
items.summary: ERA4Health's ninth joint transnational call will fund pragmatic, multinational phase III randomised investigator-initiated studies, either comparative-effectiveness trials or repurposing of off-patent drugs, in cardiovascular, metabolic, autoimmune and non-communicable respiratory diseases, with attention to diverse and underrepresented populations (up to 48 months). The pre-announcement says the call will be published on 27 October 2026; budget and deadlines are not yet public. The Netherlands/ZonMw is not among the expected funders, so Dutch teams should check the call text on how they can take part. The deadline shown is an estimate (Trials4Health 2026 pre-proposal date + 1 year).
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium; participating funders listed in pre-announcement (no Dutch funder)

items.name: KNAW Early Career Partnerships 2026
items.summary: KNAW Early Career Partnerships: EUR 10,000 to organise an interdisciplinary science meeting, for researchers 3-7 years post-PhD at a Dutch university or research institute (KNAW extension rules apply). Up to ten partnerships per year. The next round opens on 1 November 2026; the closing date is not yet published (the 2026 round closed in early February).

items.name: Dekker Grants 2027 (Postdoc, Senior Scientist, Clinical Scientist)
items.summary: Four Dekker grant types were open: Postdoc (3 positions, 2-3 years), Senior Scientist, Clinical Scientist, and Senior Clinical Scientist. External submission deadline was 3 February 2026 14:00. Monitor for 2027 round opening ~Dec 2026.

items.name: EUP OHAMR 2nd Joint Transnational Call – Preventing Emergence & Spread of AMR
items.summary: The European Partnership on One Health AMR (EUP OHAMR) runs joint transnational calls with national funders (e.g. ZonMw for NL). Its first call (JTC 2026, treatments and adherence to treatment protocols; over EUR 31M from 37 funders in 28 countries) opened 18 November 2025, with pre-proposals due 2 February 2026 and full proposals 17 June 2026. A second call has not yet been announced on ohamr.eu; the deadline shown is a placeholder based on the first call's timing. Relevant for antimicrobial stewardship, adherence and drug-utilisation research.
items.partnersNote: Transnational consortium across multiple partner countries; national funding via participating agencies (e.g. ZonMw for NL)

items.name: THCS Joint Transnational Call 2027 (Transforming Health and Care Systems, expected)
items.funder: THCS Partnership (Transforming Health and Care Systems)
items.summary: The Horizon Europe co-funded THCS partnership has run a joint transnational call every year (2023 Healthcare of the Future, 2024 Innovate to Prevent, 2025 Better care closer to home, 2026 Access to Care). ZonMw, NWO and NIVEL are Dutch partners. A 2027 call has not been announced. The 2026 call opened in November 2025, with pre-proposals due 2 February 2026 and full proposals due 30 June 2026; the date here is an estimate based on that pattern.
items.partnersNote: Transnational consortium with partners from several participating countries.

items.name: EP PerMed Joint Transnational Call 2027 (JTC2027)
items.summary: EP PerMed runs a yearly joint transnational call for multinational personalised medicine projects; the 2026 call (CARMEN2026, about EUR 38M, ZonMw participating) was published in late November 2025. No 2027 call has been announced yet. EP PerMed says it has no information on upcoming calls, so the topic, budget and dates are not known. The deadline shown is an estimate (JTC2026 pre-proposal date of 10 Feb + 1 year).
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium across participating EP PerMed countries

items.name: Erasmus+ Capacity Building in Higher Education 2027
items.summary: Erasmus+ CBHE funds international consortia that modernise higher education in partner countries, which could suit pharmacy and pharmacoepidemiology education projects. In the 2026 call there were three strands, with grants from EUR 200k (Strand 1) up to EUR 1M (Strand 3), and the deadline was 10 February 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time. The 2027 call has not been published yet. The deadline shown is an estimate (2026 date + 1 year).
items.partnersNote: International consortium with partners from eligible programme and partner countries

items.name: NVKFB Proefschriftprijs (clinical pharmacology dissertation)
items.summary: EUR 1,000 annual NVKFB prize for a dissertation on clinical pharmacological or biopharmaceutical research from a university in the Dutch-language region, by an NVKFB member (self-nomination allowed). The promotion may be at most three years before the award, and a candidate can be nominated only once. Submit the thesis PDF to info@nvkfb.nl; the current reglement (May 2026) states no deadline, and the next round is expected around mid-February 2027.
items.partnersNote: NVKFB membership required

items.name: NVKFB TOP-Publicatieprijs (best clinical pharmacology publication)
items.summary: EUR 500 educational grant awarded each year by the NVKFB for the best original clinical pharmacology article (English or Dutch, peer-reviewed) published in the previous calendar year with an NVKFB member working in the Dutch-speaking region as first author. One submission per member per year; reviews, editorials and abstracts are excluded. NVKFB sends members a yearly call; no deadline is published yet (expected around February 2027).
items.partnersNote: NVKFB membership required

items.name: ERDERA Joint Transnational Call 2027 (expected)
items.summary: ERDERA, the European Rare Diseases Research Alliance, runs a yearly two-stage joint transnational call for multinational rare-disease research consortia. The 2027 topic and dates have not been published. The pre-proposal deadline shown is an estimate from the 2026 JTC (pre-proposals 12 February, full proposals 8 July 2026). ERDERA's separate 2026 Clinical Trial Call is open but required an expression of interest by 10 September 2026.
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium (several countries); check 2027 call text

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027 Adverse Drug Reactions – Personalised Approaches
items.summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-CARE-02 (RIA, single stage): personalised approaches to reduce adverse drug reactions in patients taking three or more medicines, especially with comorbidities. Proposals should combine pharmacogenomics and other biomarkers for stratification with EHRs, AI and clinical decision support, assess clinical utility and cost-effectiveness, and feed results into EMA and national (de)prescribing guidance. EUR 38M for about 4 projects of EUR 8-10M. Highly relevant for PECP. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.
items.partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 countries)

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage – AI for Predictive Biomarkers in Chronic NCDs
items.summary: Horizon Europe two-stage RIA HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage: developing predictive biomarkers of disease progression and treatment response with AI methods for chronic non-communicable diseases. EUR 44.2M for about 6 projects of EUR 6-8M. Opens 29 October 2026; first-stage deadline 17 February 2027, second-stage deadline 16 September 2027. Highly relevant for the division's AI/data science and pharmacoepi work.
items.partnersNote: International consortium, min. 3 entities from 3 EU/associated countries

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-08 – New Antibacterial & Antifungal Therapies
items.summary: Horizon Europe RIA HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-08 for innovative antimicrobials against resistant pathogens; each proposal targets one of CRAB, CRE/third-generation cephalosporin-resistant Enterobacterales, carbapenem-resistant P. aeruginosa, MRSA, drug-resistant Aspergillus fumigatus or drug-resistant Candida. Phage therapies are out of scope. EUR 44.2M for about 5 projects of EUR 8-10M. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.
items.partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-ENVHLTH-02 – Climate-related Exposures in the Human Exposome
items.summary: Horizon Europe RIA (call HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01, single stage) on integrating climate-related exposures such as heat, air pollution and drought into large human exposome studies and modelling how the exposome shifts under climate change. Projects should use AI and real-world data, address social and demographic vulnerability, include social sciences and humanities, and share outputs via IHEN platforms and the European Climate and Health Observatory. EUR 45M for about 4 projects of EUR 10-11M. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.
items.partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-05/06/07 – Antivirals & Monoclonal Antibodies
items.summary: Three single-stage RIA topics in call HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01: DISEASE-05 novel small-molecule antivirals for pathogens with epidemic potential (EUR 44.2M, ~5 projects of EUR 9-11M; one of six named virus groups, antibodies excluded), DISEASE-06 monoclonal antibodies against flaviviruses and DISEASE-07 monoclonal antibodies against filo-, nairo-, phenui-, picorna- and togaviruses (each EUR 37.3M, ~4 projects of EUR 9-10M). Work runs from discovery to GMP batches and first-in-human safety studies. Relevant mainly as a partner for clinical pharmacology and safety work packages. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.
items.partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-DISEASE-01 – Innovative Healthcare Interventions for Non-Communicable Diseases (two-stage)
items.summary: Research and Innovation Action funding early-stage (phase 1/2 for drugs) clinical trials of new or refined pharmacological or non-pharmacological interventions for cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic respiratory disease or chronic kidney disease. Applicants need prior proof-of-concept and a draft protocol, plus a health-economic assessment and real-world data analysis; comparative-effectiveness studies are out of scope. Expected EU contribution is €7–8 million per project (about 8 projects). The call opens 29 October 2026, with the first stage due 17 February 2027 and the second stage due 16 September 2027. The Funding & Tenders portal shows different (later) dates for some 2027 health topics than the work programme; check the portal before planning.
items.partnersNote: Standard Horizon Europe consortium (at least 3 independent entities from 3 EU/associated countries); SSH expertise required.

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-10 – Chronic NCDs in Children and Young People (GACD implementation research)
items.summary: Implementation research on preventing, screening, diagnosing and managing chronic non-communicable diseases in people aged 1–24 in low- and middle-income countries and/or underserved high-income populations, aligned with the 12th Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases call. Projects must use hybrid effectiveness-implementation designs and equitable HIC–LMIC leadership; pharmacological trials and aetiological cohorts are excluded. Expected EU contribution is €3–4 million per project (about 3 projects). The single-stage call opens 29 October 2026 and closes 17 February 2027. The Funding & Tenders portal shows different (later) dates for some 2027 health topics than the work programme; check the portal before planning.
items.partnersNote: Equitable partnership and shared leadership between HIC and LMIC (and/or Indigenous) members; at least one early-career co-investigator.

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-DISEASE-14 – Clinical Trials for Neurodegenerative Diseases (two-stage)
items.summary: Research and Innovation Action for clinical trials that advance innovative interventions for neurodegenerative diseases. Expected EU contribution is around €10 million per project (about 4 projects). The call opens 29 October 2026, with the first stage due 17 February 2027 and the second stage due 16 September 2027. The detailed topic scope was not read, so check the work programme. The Funding & Tenders portal shows different (later) dates for some 2027 health topics than the work programme; check the portal before planning.
items.partnersNote: Standard Horizon Europe consortium (at least 3 entities from 3 EU/associated countries).

items.name: VSBfonds Beurs 2027 (study/research abroad after bachelor)
items.summary: VSBfonds scholarship for socially engaged graduates with at least a bachelor's degree for a short study, research stay or master's abroad starting after 1 July of the following year. It cannot be part of a Dutch degree programme, and internships do not qualify. Under the UU conditions for the last cycle, applicants need Dutch nationality, and the grant is up to €7,000 (up to €10,000 for a two-year programme). There is one round a year: it opens in autumn and closes on 1 March, so the 2027 date is estimated.
items.partnersNote: Application via contact person at the Dutch institution (UU)

items.name: Global Health EDCTP3 – Joint Calls 2026
items.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 funds clinical research and capacity building on infectious diseases and health challenges in sub-Saharan Africa. Its 2026 work programme (about EUR 147M) covered TB, lower respiratory tract infections, HIV co-morbidities, climate and health, and CSAs on ethics/regulatory/pharmacovigilance training networks and digital/AI; all 2026 deadlines have passed (RIA full proposals 17 September 2026). The 2027 work programme is not yet published; the deadline shown is a placeholder based on the 2026 first-stage date (4 March 2026).
items.partnersNote: Consortium with African partners required

items.name: Vici – Science Domain 2027
items.summary: NWO Talent Programme grant of up to EUR 1.5M for senior researchers (PhD within 15 years of the benchmark date) to build a research group. The 2027 round has not been published; the pre-proposal deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (pre-proposal 10 Mar 2026, full proposal 8 Sep 2026) and is not confirmed.

items.name: Vici – ZonMw Health Research Domain 2027
items.summary: Vici grant via the ZonMw (health research) domain: up to EUR 1.5M for senior researchers with PhD within 15 years. The 2027 round has not been published; the pre-proposal deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (10 Mar 2026 pre-proposal, 8 Sep 2026 full proposal) and is not confirmed. Applicants choose one domain only.

items.name: EP BrainHealth Joint Transnational Call 2027 (NWO/Hersenstichting)
items.summary: Transnational calls of the European Partnership for Brain Health, with NWO and the Brain Foundation Netherlands funding Dutch partners (2026: max EUR 400k per Dutch project, consortia of 3-6 partners). The 2026 calls (pre-proposals 10 Mar, full proposals 30 Jun 2026) are under review; no 2027 call has been announced, so the date shown is projected and not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium of 3-6 partners

items.name: Open Mind 2027 (expected)
items.summary: NWO Applied and Engineering Sciences funds daring ideas with societal impact through Open Mind: about 10 grants of up to €100,000 for at most one year. Researchers at Dutch universities, UMCs and institutes can apply, including postdocs and PhD candidates who hold a master's degree. NWO runs one round a year. The 2027 call has not been published, so the deadline is estimated from 2026 (10 March) and is not confirmed.

items.name: ERC Proof of Concept 2027 (cut-offs Mar & Sep 2027)
items.summary: Lump sum of €150,000 over 18 months for current or recent ERC grantees who want to test the commercial or societal potential of results from their ERC project. Under ERC Work Programme 2027 the call ERC-2027-PoC opens 12 November 2026 and has two cut-offs, 10 March 2027 and 16 September 2027 (budget €60M, ~400 grants). The ERC calls these dates provisional.

items.name: ISPE 43rd ICPE 2027 – Travel Scholarships (expected)
items.summary: ISPE Annual Meeting Scholarship for the 43rd ISPE Annual Meeting, 21-25 August 2027 in Seattle (USA). The 2026 Milan round closed 12 March 2026. The 2027 scholarship call has not yet been published; deadline shown is an estimate (~March 2027).

items.name: PRISMA Proefschrift Prijs 2026 (pharmacy practice research)
items.summary: Annual PRISMA Thesis Prize for dissertations defended in the previous 2 years at a Dutch or Belgian university, on new insights from pharmaceutical practice research implemented in community or hospital pharmacy. Evaluated on degree of implementation, translatability to pharmacist care, and scientific quality. Awarded at the PRISMA symposium (12 May 2026, Breukelen). Submit via prisma@knmp.nl.

items.name: ICPE Annual Meeting Scholarships (student travel award)
items.summary: ISPE awards travel scholarships (transportation + hotel reimbursement) for the ICPE Annual Meeting to students and researchers from developing countries or in financial need. 2026 deadline was 12 March 2026; 2027 round expected around March 2027. Criteria: accepted abstract, student status, country of residence, financial need. Directly relevant for PhDs at the Centre for Pharmacoepidemiology.
items.partnersNote: ISPE student membership + accepted abstract favoured

items.name: Off Road 2027 – High-Risk High-Reward Research (expected)
items.summary: ZonMw grants for curiosity-driven, high-risk biomedical and health research aiming at a proof of concept, for researchers 2 to 6 years after their PhD. In 2026 the grants were up to €100,000 for 12 to 18 months, plus an optional €30,000 module for animal-free methods (NAMs). The 2027 round has not been announced, so the deadline is estimated from 2026 (24 March) and is not confirmed.

items.name: NAM Collaboration Grant 2026 (animal-free methods knowledge transfer)
items.summary: Small grants of up to €30,000 for up to 12 months to transfer animal-free methods (New Approach Methodologies such as organ-on-chip systems and organoids) between a transferring lab and a receiving lab at Dutch research organisations. Each partner must account for at least 20% of the budget. Applications are assessed in order of arrival until 30 March 2027, and the call may close early if the money runs out.
items.partnersNote: Receiving lab (main applicant) and transferring lab (co-applicant), both at a Dutch research organisation; may be at the same institution if in different departments.

items.name: Critical Pathways Community Fund 2027 (Pathways to Sustainability)
items.summary: Small fund from the Critical Pathways community (part of UU Pathways to Sustainability) for initiatives that strengthen the community, involve other members and encourage interdisciplinary exchange. Any UU employee or student can be the main applicant, and research or admin assistance can be covered. Each round has €5,000 in total. In 2026 there were three rounds (31 March, 18 June, 7 October); no 2027 dates are published yet, so the date shown is estimated.

items.name: Trailblazers Fund / Baanbrekersfonds 2027
items.summary: 2026 round closed 29 April 2026. Next round expected spring 2027 (deadline TBC). For early-career first-generation academics. €5,000 (PhD) or €10,000 (postdoc/assistant professor) for professional development and network building. ~25% success rate.

items.name: Jan Prins Proefschriftprijs 2026 (antibiotic stewardship)
items.summary: €1,000 prize for an innovative, impactful PhD dissertation on antimicrobial resistance, antimicrobial stewardship or antibiotic policy. Eligibility: defended at a Dutch university between 1 Jan 2025 and 1 Jan 2026. Submission closed 1 April 2026. Winner will be announced at the SWAB Symposium (25 June 2026). Next round expected early 2027.

items.name: Wellcome Climate Impacts Awards 2027
items.summary: Up to GBP 2.5M over up to 3 years for transdisciplinary teams that make the health effects of climate change visible to people who can drive climate action (about 10-15 awards per round). The administering organisation can be a not-for-profit anywhere except mainland China. The last round closed on 8 April 2026, and Wellcome has not yet published the next key date. The deadline shown is an estimate (2026 date + 1 year).
items.partnersNote: Transdisciplinary team incl. stakeholders who can drive climate action

items.name: MSCA Staff Exchanges 2027
items.summary: Funds short-term international and intersectoral secondments (1-12 months) of research, technical and administrative staff within joint R&I projects. The 2027 call has an indicative budget of EUR 95.04M. The consortium needs at least three entities in three different countries and both academic and non-academic partners. The MSCA site gives indicative dates of 15 December 2026 (opening) and 15 April 2027 (deadline), both still to be confirmed; FFG lists 13 April 2027, so check the portal.
items.partnersNote: Min. 3 independent entities in 3 different countries, at least 2 in different EU/associated countries; academic and non-academic sectors

items.name: IHI Call 14 (expected)
items.summary: The Innovative Health Initiative publishes public-private calls about twice a year. Call 12 was single-stage with a 21 April 2026 deadline, and Call 13 had a stage 1 deadline of 8 October 2026. Call 14 has not been announced and no draft topics are published yet. The deadline shown is an estimate based on the spring pattern; draft topics usually appear on IHI's Future opportunities page a few months before launch.
items.partnersNote: Public-private consortium including industry partners

items.name: CARB-X 2027 Funding Round – Antibacterial Products (expected)
items.summary: CARB-X funds early-stage development of antibacterial therapeutics, preventives and diagnostics through themed funding rounds. In 2026, expressions of interest were open from 8 to 22 April for four themes (Gram-negative therapeutics, novel chemistry, neonatal sepsis prevention and neonatal sepsis diagnostics). No 2027 round has been announced. The deadline shown is an estimate (2026 date + 1 year).

items.name: BRAINS 2027 PPS Call – Brain Research Collaboration
items.summary: Public-private consortium call from five Dutch brain health funds with Health~Holland, part of a 10-year programme (EUR 15M) on cross-disorder problems such as drug delivery across the blood-brain barrier, connected neurotech and human brain models. A 2027 call has not been announced; the date shown is projected from the 2026 pre-proposal deadline (24 Apr 2026) and is not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Public-private partnership required

items.name: FIP World Congress 2027 – Travel Scholarships (expected)
items.summary: Congress travel scholarships (typically six) for the next FIP World Congress of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences (2027). The 2026 Montreal round has closed. The 2027 congress grants/scholarships page is not yet live; deadline expected spring 2027 (TBC). Includes a Leadership Development Workshop.

items.name: ISPOR 2027 Conference Travel Grants (Student, Member, Patient)
items.summary: ISPOR 2027 travel grants: Student, Member, and Patient Representative Travel Grants; includes complimentary registration and travel reimbursement. The 2026 round has closed. 2027 applications expected to open early 2027 (deadline TBC). Directly relevant for pharmacoepi, HTA and health-economics researchers.
items.partnersNote: ISPOR membership required

items.name: FIP Hospital Pharmacy Section (HPS) Research Grant 2027
items.summary: A small grant (up to EUR 3,000 per project in 2026) for research led by FIP Hospital Pharmacy Section members on putting the revised Basel Statements into practice. Patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship and competency development get priority, and overheads are not allowed. The 2026 round ran from 1 March to 1 May 2026. No 2027 round has been announced yet; the dates shown are estimates from the 2026 cycle.

items.name: BPS-FIP Foundation Collaborative Research Grant 2027
items.summary: A single grant of up to EUR 5,000 from the Board of Pharmacy Specialties, run through the FIP Foundation, for investigators based outside the US. It funds studies on how pharmacist board certification affects patient outcomes, health systems, interprofessional collaboration or pharmacist employment and wellbeing. BPS says the next call will be announced in March 2027. The 1 May deadline is an estimate based on the 2026 round (3 March to 1 May 2026).

items.name: EACPT 2027 Congress (Lille) – Travel Grants
items.summary: EACPT gives travel grants of up to €500 to students, PhD candidates and specialist trainees with an accepted abstract at its biennial congress. EACPT 2027 is in Lille, France, on 26–29 June 2027. For the 2025 Helsinki congress the deadline was 5 May 2025. The 2027 call is not yet published, so the date shown is estimated.

items.name: ERC Synergy Grant 2027
items.summary: For groups of 2-4 PIs with complementary skills to tackle ambitious research problems. Up to €10M for 6 years (+€4M for relocation/equipment). 2026 round received record 957 proposals. 2027 round RESCHEDULED: opening moved to February 2027, deadline May 2027 (confirmed by ERC). Bottom-up: any research topic. Stricter resubmission restrictions in 2027. Excellent fit for cross-disciplinary pharmacoepi/HTA/data science collaborations.
items.partnersNote: 2-4 PIs from different research groups, complementary expertise required

items.name: Joint EPHAR–EACPT Young Investigator Awards in Translational Pharmacology
items.summary: Two awards of €1,000 each for young scientists with an outstanding translational pharmacology publication in the preceding two years. Awarded at the EACPT Congress; 2025 awards presented in Helsinki. Next EACPT Congress cycle expected 2027. Fits clinical pharmacology PhDs and early-career postdocs.
items.partnersNote: EACPT or EPHAR affiliation

items.name: FIP / IPSF Early-Career Congress Grant (FIP 2027)
items.summary: Up to €1,500 per awardee toward transport, accommodation and registration for the FIP World Congress of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences. Targeted at ECPG / IPSF members. The 2026 Montreal round has closed; the 2027 congress-grant page is not yet live, deadline expected spring 2027 (TBC).
items.partnersNote: ECPG or IPSF membership

items.name: Pathways to Sustainability Incubator Grants 2027
items.summary: Annual UU Pathways to Sustainability grant for interdisciplinary teams (UU scholars from at least two faculties, external partners welcome) to build a community and develop a new sustainability idea over 12 months. Teams get up to €8,000, paid in two tranches; at most five grants a year, and awardees must attend a Kickstarter workshop. Incubator teams can later apply for a Signature Project Grant (from 2027 up to three a year, max €125,000 each). PtS expects the next round in spring 2027. The date shown is estimated from the 2026 deadline (20 May 2026).
items.partnersNote: Active UU scholars from multiple disciplines and at least two faculties; external partners optional

items.name: ICRPA 2027 – International Cardiovascular Research Partnership Awards (expected)
items.summary: Joint call from the BHF, Dutch Heart Foundation, DZHK, Lefoulon-Delalande Foundation, CNIC and CIBER-CV for future leaders in cardiovascular research. Each project is co-led by at least three independent mid-career PIs in different participating countries, and each funder pays its own country's share (up to €/£500,000 each, €400,000 for DZHK) for up to 4 years. The 2026 round (the 8th) closed 27 May 2026. A 2027 round has not been announced, so the deadline is estimated and is not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: At least 3 independent mid-career PIs from different participating countries (France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK)

items.name: ZonMw Open Competition M – Mid-Career Pilot (2027)
items.summary: ZonMw pilot Open Competition M (OC-M) for mid-career researchers doing independent, curiosity-driven fundamental (bio)medical research in any discipline; max EUR 400,000 per project. The first round opens in spring 2027 (pilot rounds in 2027 and 2029, alternating with OC-L), with the call text expected in early 2027. Deadline not yet known. The date shown is a placeholder for the end of spring 2027 until ZonMw publishes the call.

items.name: ACPE 2026 Melbourne – Travel Scholarships
items.summary: Travel scholarships for the Asian Conference on Pharmacoepidemiology (ACPE) 2026 in Melbourne, Australia. Deadline 12 June 2026. Good opportunity for early-career pharmacoepi researchers to present and network. [2026 Melbourne scholarship round closed 12 Jun 2026; rolled forward to expected next annual cycle.]

items.name: Van Walree Fund 2026
items.summary: Up to €10,000 for early career researchers in medical, biomedical, or health sciences. Supports sustainable and innovative initiatives for international knowledge sharing. [2026 cycle closed 15 Jun 2026; rolled forward to expected June 2027 deadline.]

items.name: KNAW Early Career Award 2027
items.summary: KNAW Early Career Award: up to 12 awards of €15,000 each (max 3 per Academy domain) for researchers 3-7 years post-PhD who do not yet hold an associate/full professor position. Recognises innovative contributions to science and scientific practice. Nominations open until 1 July 2026. Ceremony December 2026 at Trippenhuis, Amsterdam. Contributions may relate to Recognition & Rewards themes: research, education, impact, patient care, leadership.

items.name: Longfonds-Swierenga Grant 2027 – Rare Lung Disease Research
items.summary: Up to EUR 50,000 for a one-year project by an early-career researcher (PhD or confirmed defence date; also clinicians/nurses with research track record) at a Dutch institution, on rare pulmonary diseases only (asthma, COPD and lung cancer excluded). Longfonds states the 2027 call opens in April 2027 (offered annually 2025-2029); the deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (3 Jul 2026) and not confirmed.

items.name: Science for Industry Call 2027
items.summary: Health~Holland PPP call for collaborations led by a Dutch company with at least one Dutch research organisation; the 2026 round offered at least EUR 5M in total and EUR 0.5-1.2M PPP subsidy per project, with mandatory pre-registration. A 2027 round has not been announced; the date shown is projected from the 2026 pre-registration (14 Jul 2026; full application 22 Sep 2026) and is not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Min. 1 Dutch for-profit company (lead applicant) + 1 Dutch research organisation; co-financing required

items.name: Prix Galien Bridges 2026 – Nordic Innovation Awards (incl. Netherlands)
items.summary: Prix Galien Bridges Awards. Partnership between Nordic countries and 5 strategic partners including the Netherlands. Recognizes biopharma innovation. The 2026 nomination round closed 31 July 2026; rolled forward to the expected next annual cycle (~July 2027 — confirm exact date on the Galien Foundation page). Relevant for division researchers with translational pharmaceutical innovations.

items.name: Open Competition Domain Science – M 2026/2027
items.summary: NWO's continuous open competition for curiosity-driven research in the Science domain. The 2026/2027 round was expected to open in August 2026 and closes when 420 proposals are reached (assessed in five packages) or at the latest on 31 July 2027; new restrictions apply to applicants with ongoing NWO/ZonMw projects. In the previous round grants were up to EUR 400k (single applicant) or EUR 800k (with co-applicant); verify current amounts on the call page.

items.name: KNAW Van Leersum Beurs (research visit abroad – pharmacy/neurology/radiology)
items.summary: Van Leersum Beurs: €2,900–€9,000 for a 1–4 month research visit abroad for PhD candidates or researchers who obtained their PhD ≤4 years ago, in pharmacy (incl. medicinal plants), neurology or radiology at a Dutch institution. The 2026 round closed 3 August 2026; rolled forward to the expected next annual cycle (~early August 2027 — confirm exact date on the KNAW page). Excellent option for division PhDs wanting to strengthen international collaboration.
items.partnersNote: Host at a foreign university/institute

items.name: ERC Advanced Grant 2027
items.summary: ERC Work Programme 2027 (adopted). For established research leaders with a significant track record. Call opens 27 May 2027; deadline 26 August 2027. Up to €2.5M for 5 years (plus up to €1M additional, incl. Choose Europe relocation top-up). Bottom-up: any research topic. Budget ~€798M, ~311 grants expected. Successor to the 2026 round (ID 25).

items.name: SME Call 2026 – Round 2
items.summary: ~€12M total in PPP subsidy for public-private partnerships focused on innovative industrial research within LSH. Min €225k, max €450k per project. Round 1 closed 31 March 2026 (results mid-May). Round 2 expected later in 2026.
items.partnersNote: Public-private partnership with SME required

items.name: Efficiency Studies Programme
items.summary: ZonMw programme generating evidence on effectiveness and costs of interventions to support decision-making on introducing or abolishing interventions in Dutch healthcare. Key for HTA-oriented research. Focus on affordable, high-quality healthcare.
items.partnersNote: Stakeholder involvement (healthcare professionals, patients, insurers) required

items.name: FIP ECPG Innovation Research Grant 2026
items.summary: FIP Early Career Professional Group and FIP Foundation Innovation Research Grant. Specifically for early career pharmacists and pharmaceutical scientists. Launch expected Q2 2026. Good for early-career researchers in pharmacy practice and drug utilisation.

items.name: Novo Nordisk Foundation – Health Research Grants
items.summary: One of Europe's largest private research foundations. Multiple grant schemes including Challenge Programme, Collaboration Grants, and Distinguished Investigator Awards. Strong focus on cardiometabolic, diabetes, rare disease, and AMR research. Also funded the $60M AMR initiative with Gates/Wellcome.

items.name: Exploratory Interdisciplinary Synergy Programme 2026
items.summary: DKK 68M annual budget. Up to DKK 6.8M per project for up to 3 years. Must align with NNF focus areas: Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, Natural/Technical Sciences with health or sustainability applicability. Good for cross-disciplinary pharmacoepi proposals.
items.partnersNote: Interdisciplinary team required

items.name: RECRUIT Programme 2026 – International Recruitment Grants
items.summary: RECRUIT grants (DKK 22-55M for up to 7 years), RECRUIT Sabbatical grants (DKK 1M for up to 1 year), and RECRUIT Extension grants (DKK 10M for up to 5 years). For recruiting outstanding international researchers to Denmark/Nordic region. Spring 2026 call opens May. Relevant for attracting top pharmacoepi talent.

items.name: Nierstichting–Health~Holland PPS Call
items.summary: Joint PPS call between Nierstichting and Health~Holland for kidney research with industry collaboration. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on nephrotoxicity, drug dosing in kidney disease, and medication safety in renal patients. Monitor Health~Holland website for call opening.
items.partnersNote: Public-private partnership required with industry partner

items.name: Longfonds Junior Investigator Grants 2026 – New Round
items.summary: Three grants of up to EUR 250,000 each for early-career lung disease researchers. Includes one special CPBT grant for Animal-Free Biomedical Translation (Asthma & COPD). Patient involvement required.

items.name: ERA-AD 2026 – European Research Area for Alzheimer's Disease
items.summary: ERA-AD 2026 supports international collaborative research on Alzheimer's disease and other dementias. Alzheimer Nederland participates as a funding partner. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on dementia medications, polypharmacy in elderly, and anti-amyloid drug safety monitoring.
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium across ERA-AD partner countries

items.name: Longfonds Consortium Grant 2026
items.summary: €2.1M total for 3 research consortia (€700,000 each) for promising and innovative research into prevention, treatment, and cure of chronic lung diseases. Pre-proposal deadline expected Q3 2026. Patient involvement required. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on respiratory drug safety, inhaler adherence, and COPD/asthma pharmacotherapy.
items.partnersNote: Consortium of multiple research groups required; patient involvement mandatory

items.name: NNF Start Package Grants for Faculty Recruitment 2026
items.summary: Start Package Grants to recruit outstanding researchers into tenure-track or professor-level positions at Danish universities, hospitals, and non-profit research organisations. Strategic focus areas include health/life sciences, sustainability, and natural/technical sciences. Q1 2026 round published. Relevant for researchers considering positions at Danish institutions with pharmacoepi/drug safety focus.

items.name: EULAR-ACR Transatlantic Research Exchange Programme 2026
items.summary: Joint programme between EULAR and American College of Rheumatology supporting transatlantic research exchanges in rheumatic and musculoskeletal disease research. Relevant for pharmacoepi collaborations on DMARDs, biologicals, biosimilars, and medication safety in autoimmune conditions.

items.name: EP PerMed Twinning Call 2026 – Implementation Exchange
items.summary: EP PerMed Twinning programme for peer-to-peer exchange on personalised medicine implementation across countries. Max €50K per project. Lower threshold than full JTC calls – good entry point for establishing international personalised medicine collaborations. Relevant for pharmacogenetics implementation research.
items.partnersNote: Peer-to-peer exchange between institutions in different EP PerMed partner countries

items.name: NNF Distinguished Innovator Grant Programme 2026
items.summary: Up to DKK 7.6M (€1M) for senior researchers in the Nordic region to accelerate commercialisation of research-based innovations in Health and Sustainability. Relevant for translating pharmacoepidemiology findings, drug safety tools, or AI-based methods into practice or market applications.

items.name: NNF Endocrinology & Metabolism Project Grants 2026
items.summary: Up to DKK 2M per year for up to 3 years for basic, clinical, and translational research in endocrine and metabolic health. Open to Nordic country researchers. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on diabetes medications (GLP-1 agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors), cardiometabolic drug safety, and drug utilisation patterns.

items.name: ESCP Fellowship & Research Awards 2026
items.summary: ESCP offers Fellowship recognition and early-career research awards for clinical pharmacy research. The society prioritises research on medication safety, polypharmacy, antimicrobial stewardship, and pharmacy practice innovation. Awards typically announced at ESCP annual symposium. Relevant for Centre for Clinical Therapeutics and pharmacy practice researchers.

items.name: RECRUIT Programme 2026 – Spring Call (May)
items.summary: RECRUIT grants (DKK 22–55M for up to 7 years) to attract outstanding international researchers to Denmark/Nordic region. Spring 2026 call opens May. Also includes RECRUIT Sabbatical (DKK 1M for up to 1 year) and RECRUIT Extension grants. For researchers considering positions at Nordic institutions with pharmacoepi/drug safety focus.

items.name: Veni – Science Domain 2027
items.summary: New 2026 Veni round for Science domain expected to open summer 2026, with pre-proposal deadline around September 2026. Previous round (2025) had pre-proposals due Sep 2025, full proposals due Jan 2026. €320,000 for 3 years. PhD obtained ≤3 years ago. Expanded 500-word research idea pilot continues. Rolled forward: the 2026 Veni Science round closed its pre-proposal stage on 1 Sep 2026. The next (2027) Veni Science round is expected to open for pre-proposals around September 2027; exact dates to be announced by NWO.

items.name: Kolff+ Programme 2026 – Call 3
items.summary: Third 2026 call of the Kolff+ programme expected to open later in 2026. Multiple grant types: Student Researcher, Creativity, Junior/Senior Talent, Success Accelerator. Call 2 pre-proposal deadline passed 14 April 2026. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on drug-induced kidney injury and medication safety in renal patients.

items.name: Exploration Call 2026-2
items.summary: Second 2026 Exploration call for fundamental cancer research. Young Investigator Grant (YIG) proposals must now be submitted under a separate call. Exploration Call 2026-1 closed 1 May 2026 (see ID 74). Relevant for pharmacoepi research on anticancer drug safety.

items.name: ERC Plus Grant 2027
items.summary: Second round of the ERC Plus Grant: up to €7M per project for transformative, high-ambition research, open to PIs at any career stage. ERC Work Programme 2027 gives ERC-2027-PLUS a provisional opening of 1 June 2027 and a deadline of 1 September 2027, with a budget of €210M and about 30 grants.

items.name: EU4Health 2027 Work Programme – Action Grants incl. Conference Grants (expected)
items.summary: The Commission is preparing the EU4Health 2027 work programme, the last under the 2021-2027 programme. A targeted consultation ran until 12 June 2026 around five strands: crisis preparedness, health promotion and prevention, health systems and workforce, digital transformation, and cancer, cardiovascular and other NCDs. Calls, including the recurring high-level conference grants, are expected in 2027. No calls or dates are published yet, so the deadline is an estimate.

items.name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
items.summary: Annual MSCA call for individual European and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships for researchers with a PhD, under the MSCA 2026-2027 work programme. A draft of that work programme (Nov 2025) lists HORIZON-MSCA-2027-PF-01 as opening 7 April 2027 with a deadline of 8 September 2027 and about €389M indicative budget. These dates are not yet confirmed on an official call page.

items.name: GGG – Goed Gebruik Geneesmiddelen Open Ronde 17 (2027)
items.summary: Open round of ZonMw's Good Use of Medicines programme, funding research on better, safer and more efficient medicine use. Open Ronde 16 had EUR 6M in total and up to EUR 1.5M per project, with a project-idea deadline of 14 Sep 2026 and full proposals on 2 Mar 2027. A next open round has not been announced; the project-idea deadline shown is projected (previous + 1 year) and is not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Collaboration with patient representatives, healthcare professionals and/or insurers expected (per previous rounds)

items.name: Open Competition Domain Science – XL 2027/2028 (expected)
items.summary: NWO's Domain Science XL call for large consortium projects across all Domain Science disciplines, including Life Sciences. NWO says the call runs once every two years, and the 2025/2026 round had a pre-proposal deadline of 16 September 2025. The next round has not been announced, so the pre-proposal deadline is estimated two years after the last one and is not confirmed. The budget range shown comes from the previous round.
items.partnersNote: Consortium project

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-04 – Virtual Human Twins for Clinical Decision Support in Prevention and Diagnosis
items.summary: Research and Innovation Action to build and clinically validate multi-scale, patient-specific Virtual Human Twin models that support prevention and diagnosis, including health-economic or cost-effectiveness evidence from real-world settings and plans for regulatory compliance (MDR/IVDR, AI Act). Expected EU contribution is €10–12 million per project (about 4 projects). The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027.
items.partnersNote: Multidisciplinary consortium; SSH contribution mandatory; SME participation encouraged.

items.name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-08 – Next Generation of Frontier AI Models for Healthcare (CSA)
items.summary: Coordination and Support Action (a single project of around €2.9 million) on preparing the next generation of frontier AI models for healthcare. The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027. The detailed scope was not read, so check the work programme.
items.partnersNote: Horizon Europe CSA consortium.

items.name: Mission Cancer 2027 – CANCER-04 Health-Economics, Health-Systems & Outcomes Research for Equitable Cancer Outcomes
items.summary: Research and Innovation Action (HORIZON-MISS-2027-02-CANCER-04) to develop health-economics, health-systems, epidemiological and outcomes-research methods for cancer. Funded work covers cost-effectiveness modelling, cancer-control spending linked to value-based care, inequalities, and better access to cost-effective programmes. Expected EU contribution is €5–7 million per project (about 3 projects). The call opens 10 February 2027 with a deadline of 16 September 2027 (FFG lists 15 September), and projects must join the Mission's 'Understanding' cluster.
items.partnersNote: Horizon Europe consortium; must build on Knowledge Centre on Cancer resources (ECIS, Cancer Inequalities Registry).

items.name: Dr. Saal van Zwanenberg Afstudeerprijzen 2027 (pharmaceutical master thesis)
items.summary: Three annual KHMW prizes (EUR 3,000 / 2,000 / 1,000) for the best master research reports in pharmaceutical and/or medical sciences in which medicines are central, for graduates of Dutch research universities. Entries are submitted as nominations via the KHMW prize portal. The current round closed 17 Sep 2026; the next date shown is projected (+1 year) and not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Nomination (voordracht) required

items.name: Leopold Meijler Prijs 2027 (best student thesis – drug safety)
items.summary: Annual prize (cash amount plus a ceramic artwork) for the best bachelor's or master's thesis or article on medication safety by a Medicine, Pharmacy or Health Sciences student at a Dutch university. Submissions go by e-mail to Lareb before 1 October; the 2027 edition has not been separately announced, so the date is based on this standing annual deadline.

items.name: Young Investigator Grant (YIG) Call 2028
items.summary: Annual KWF call for early-career cancer researchers (PhD at most 5 years before the deadline) to start an independent research line, with up to EUR 1M per project (about 4 years). The 2028 round has not been announced yet; the deadline shown is projected from the 2027 round (pre-proposal 6 Oct 2026, full proposal 1 Apr 2027) and is not confirmed.

items.name: NWA-ORC 2027 – Research along Routes by Consortia
items.summary: Dutch Research Agenda (NWA) call for large inter- and transdisciplinary consortia with societal partners tackling NWA questions; the 2026 round had EUR 87M in total and up to EUR 7.25M per proposal for 4-8 years, with mandatory workshops beforehand. A 2027 round has not been announced; the deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (6 Oct 2026) and is not confirmed.
items.partnersNote: Inter- and transdisciplinary consortium incl. societal (public/private) partners; workshop participation required in 2026 round

items.name: WHO Consultancy & Research Contracts
items.summary: WHO regularly commissions research on access to medicines, pharmaceutical policy, essential medicines lists, and regulatory systems. The division already has WHO CC status. Check WHO procurement portal.

items.name: EMA Framework Contracts & Tenders
items.summary: EMA publishes calls for tenders on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal and in the Official Journal (TED); open procedures are used from about EUR 140,000, smaller contracts via negotiated procedures. The division already has a framework contract with EMA. Monitor the EMA procurement page for new tenders and ex ante notices.

items.name: ISPE Research Grants & Awards
items.summary: Various awards and grants including the Distinguished Researcher Award, student awards, and research funding. Directly in the core discipline of the division.

items.name: FIP Research & Education Grants
items.summary: FIP offers various grants for pharmacy practice and education research. The division has MoU with FIP. Monitor FIP website for specific calls.

items.name: Grand Challenges – Global Health
items.summary: Various calls for innovative solutions to global health challenges. Relevant for division's work on access to medicines in LMICs and global pharmaceutical policy.

items.name: ZIN Research Commissions & Collaboration
items.summary: ZIN (Dutch Healthcare Institute) commissions research to support its HTA and reimbursement decisions. The division already has a relationship with ZIN. Monitor their procurement and research calls for HTA, cost-effectiveness, and formulary research.

items.name: MEB Research Commissions
items.summary: The Dutch Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG/MEB) occasionally commissions research related to regulatory science, pharmacovigilance, post-market surveillance, and real-world evidence. Division already has MEB relationship. Monitor Dutch government tender portal (TenderNed).

items.name: PPP Allowance (Match Call) 2026
items.summary: TKI PPP Allowance for LSH projects. Matches private in-kind contributions with public funding. Lower threshold than other Health~Holland calls. Good entry point for industry-academic pharmacoepi collaborations.
items.partnersNote: Public-private partnership required; company must contribute in-kind

items.name: Climate and Health Award – Mitigation Solutions in LMICs
items.summary: Wellcome scheme advancing climate mitigation solutions with health co-benefits in LMICs. Complements the Climate Impacts Awards. Relevant for sustainable pharmacy research on environmental impact of pharmaceuticals and green healthcare systems.

items.name: Scientific Meetings and Consultations 2026
items.summary: Up to €15,000 for scientific meetings or €2,400 for consultations. Rolling submission (≥6 months before event). Open to researchers with a doctorate, postdocs and PhD candidates in earth/environmental sciences, astronomy, chemistry, computer science, life sciences, physics, mathematics. New conditions from Jan 2026. Good for hosting pharmacoepi workshops/symposia.

items.name: Philanthropic Partnership – AI in Health (Country-Led Research)
items.summary: New $300M global health R&D partnership between Gates Foundation, Novo Nordisk Foundation, and Wellcome. Includes country-led research to guide the use of AI in health. Relevant for division's AI/data science work in pharmacoepidemiology, drug safety signal detection, and real-world evidence generation. Monitor for specific calls as they are announced.

items.name: EU4Health 2026 Work Programme – Upcoming Action Grants
items.summary: EU4Health 2026 Work Programme includes multiple action grants expected to open throughout 2026. Previous topics included AI/health data for CVD (closed Jan 2026) and medicines pricing tracker. New 2026 WP topics in development. 13 EU Member States calling for reinstated civil society operating grants. Monitor HaDEA portal for new calls as they are published.
items.partnersNote: Eligible entities from EU member states or associated countries

items.name: Wellcome Open Research Fund 2026
items.summary: Wellcome Open Research Fund supports researchers to develop and test incentives for making health research more open, accessible and reusable. Relevant for division's work on open-source pharmacoepidemiology methods, data sharing frameworks, and reproducible research practices.

items.name: Wellcome Career Development Awards – Round 3 2026
items.summary: Third 2026 round of Wellcome Career Development Awards. Deadline 24 November 2026. For mid-career researchers establishing independent programmes. Up to 8 years funding. Round 2 deadline 28 July 2026 (see ID 91). UPDATE (Sep 2026): from 25 August 2026 the Career Development Awards scheme moved to an always-open, rolling model with no fixed submission deadlines — apply at any time; proposals are considered at scheduled shortlisting/interview meetings.

items.name: KNMP Proefschrift-bijdrage (dissertation publication contribution)
items.summary: KNMP supports 15–25 PhD candidates annually with a contribution toward publication costs of their dissertation and for publishing the main findings in the Pharmaceutisch Weekblad. Aimed at pharmacy-related doctorates. Apply via the KNMP fondsen route.

items.name: Leopold Meijler Fonds – PhD Dissertation Support (Drug Safety)
items.summary: The Leopold Meijler Fonds (housed at Lareb) also supports financing of PhD dissertations in the field of drug safety and medication surveillance, beyond the annual student thesis prize (ID 152). Contact Lareb for eligibility. Relevant for PhD candidates writing dissertations on pharmacovigilance topics.

items.name: KNMP Fondsen – Onderzoek voor de Apotheker in de Praktijk
items.summary: KNMP Foundation Funds support small-scale research directly relevant to pharmacist practice. Assessment 3x per year. Applicants should be connected to pharmacy practice. Separate from the Stipendiafonds and PRISMA prize. Good for pilot studies in community/hospital pharmacy practice research.

items.name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards – Round 3 2026
items.summary: Third 2026 round of Wellcome Early-Career Awards. Deadline 10 November 2026 (confirmed via Wellcome scheme deadline schedule). For early-career researchers developing their research identity. Salary + up to £400,000 research expenses. Round 2 deadline 21 July 2026 (see ID 90). UPDATE (Sep 2026): from 25 August 2026 the Early-Career Awards scheme moved to an always-open, rolling model with no fixed submission deadlines — apply at any time; proposals are considered at scheduled shortlisting/interview meetings.

items.name: Clinical Trial Program – Cardiovascular Clinical Trials
items.summary: Hartstichting Clinical Trial Program for investigator-initiated cardiovascular clinical trials. Maximum 7-year duration. Pre-application submitted via email to research@hartstichting.nl; assessed by programme committee before invitation to full application. Two rounds per year. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on cardiovascular drug outcomes and safety.

items.name: Wellcome Discovery Awards – Always-Open (rolling)
items.summary: From 23 September 2026 the Wellcome Discovery Awards scheme becomes always-open with no submission deadlines (replacing the twice-yearly fixed rounds). Supports established researchers and teams pursuing bold, creative research related to human life, health and wellbeing; average award ~GBP 3.5M for up to 8 years. From 29 October 2026 lead applicants must be based at eligible administering organisations in the UK or in low- and middle-income countries in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia. Confirm current eligibility and application route on the scheme page before applying.

items.name: GCRFF Multinational Clinical Trials Initiative – 2027 EOI rounds
items.summary: Expression-of-interest route through which cardiovascular research funders of the Global Cardiovascular Research Funders Forum co-fund large multinational clinical trials; Dutch applicants first consult the Hartstichting and submit a pre-application form, then an EOI via the BHF grants system. Hartstichting lists it as continuously open with two rounds per year (2025 rounds: 23 May and 26 Sep); 2027 round dates are not published.
items.partnersNote: Multinational consortium across GCRFF partner countries; Hartstichting seeks co-funders

items.name: Netwerkactiviteitenregeling (network events funding)
items.summary: Contributes to the third-party costs (such as venue and catering) of national or international events that connect researchers, companies, care professionals and investors in the Dutch life sciences and health sector. Events must involve SMEs substantially, fit the Health & Care missions and have other co-funders; flights and hotels are not covered. Applications go in at least four months before the event, and a committee reviews them every two weeks.
items.partnersNote: Substantial SME participation and co-funding from other parties required.

items.name: ERDERA Networking Support Scheme (rare disease networking events)
items.summary: Funds transnational networking events, in person or hybrid, on rare diseases or rare cancers, bringing together researchers, clinicians and patient organisations. It pays up to €30,000 per event, including participants' travel and accommodation. Groups of 3–10 co-applicants from at least three countries apply, including at least one from an underrepresented country. Rounds are collected every six months while funds last (expected until April 2029), but the page does not give the next collection date.
items.partnersNote: 3–10 co-applicants from at least 3 ERDERA countries, at least one from an underrepresented country.
